name: Speed Increase
description: Increases the creature's own walking speed.

mechanics.text: While active, changes the wearer's own walking speed — doubling it, setting a floor beneath which it never falls, or adding a flat bonus, depending on this record's own featureParams.mode. Distinct from feat.speed-modification, which GRANTS an entirely new movement type (climbing/swimming/burrowing/flying) rather than changing the existing walking speed.
